policy: NIGHTHAWK releases are target-specific. Release 1 is Orange Pi Zero 3 ARM64 without Wi-Fi; Release 2 is Orange Pi Zero 3 ARM64 with Wi-Fi; Release 3 is the x86_64 PC image for compatible Intel/AMD desktops and laptops. Release 4 does not exist.

targets.name: Orange Pi Zero 3
targets.notes: Release 1 is the Orange Pi Zero 3 ARM64 image without Wi-Fi. Release 2 is the Orange Pi Zero 3 ARM64 image with Wi-Fi. Use only on the Orange Pi Zero 3 / Allwinner H618.

targets.name: Raspberry Pi family
targets.notes: Separate model-specific images and firmware are required. Do not use the Orange Pi image.

targets.name: Intel/AMD 64-bit PCs
targets.notes: Release 3 is the x86_64 PC image intended for compatible Intel/AMD 64-bit desktops and laptops. BIOS/UEFI and peripheral compatibility may vary by system; do not claim universal support without physical testing.

targets.name: Virtual machines
targets.notes: Release 3 may be tested in a compatible x86_64 virtual machine, but no separate dedicated VM release is defined here.

targets.name: Other ARM64 single-board computers
targets.notes: Each board needs its own supported bootloader, kernel, device tree, firmware, and hardware validation.

targets.name: Android phones and tablets
targets.notes: Not a standard Linux PC/SBC target. Requires per-model bootloader unlock support, device trees, kernel/vendor drivers, partition and recovery compatibility. No generic Android image is promised.
